title: Statement Notes — Payments, Reserve Credits and Refunds of Credit Balances
content:
**Note 1 — application of payments.** Payments on the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts are accepted through the listed payment channels. A payment the employer designates for a quarter is applied to that quarter. An undesignated payment is applied to the oldest quarter with a balance first, and within a quarter to contribution or reimbursement, then interest, then penalty.

**Note 2 — reserve credit.** The contribution part of each payment is credited to the reserve account of a contributory employer. Payments of reimbursement bills, interest and penalty are never credited to the reserve.

**Note 3 — credit balances.** A credit balance is applied to the next quarter due unless the employer requests a refund.

**Note 4 — refund time limit.** A refund of a credit balance is issued only when it is requested no later than the refund limit after the payment that created the credit. The limit is counted in calendar months from the payment date, a month-end payment date falling back to the last day of a shorter month, and a request on the last day is in time. The payment date is the entry date of that payment in the account's balance history.

**Note 5 — former clause.** The clause "An approved refund is issued within the refund processing business days for no more than the credit balance, and is recorded against the refund request." is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for credit balance refunds.

## Reserve credit illustration (hypothetical contributory employer)

A payment of USD 1,000.00 is applied USD 900.00 to contribution, USD 60.00 to interest and USD 40.00 to penalty. The reserve account is credited USD 900.00. Had the employer been reimbursing, the same payment against a reimbursement bill would credit nothing to a reserve.

## Refund limit, both sides (hypothetical, limit of 36 calendar months)

| Payment that created the credit | Last day of the limit | Request on the last day | Request the day after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 June 2023 | 15 June 2026 | In time | Too late |
| 29 February 2024 (month-end) | 28 February 2027, the last day of the shorter month | In time | Too late |

superseded_clauses: An approved refund is issued within the refund processing business days for no more than the credit balance, and is recorded against the refund request.
